capture_counter_issue: The motor-locked accumulator intentionally saturates at 65535 samples to protect int32 sums and then rejects additions; the long capture plus wait reached that limit. A DAP reset cleared it for the successful retry. Check sat=0 before using a capture.
forward_repeat_trial_note: Positive forward-weighted count agrees with the previously established sign. The whole elevated segment predicts only 7.35cm forward and 2.65cm right under the old nominal scale, but exact 20cm motion endpoints were not isolated and attitude/height changed; this is a sensor-response check only.
controlled_forward_note: 35.005s capture, 176 telemetry rows, one partial frame, serial released, motor_command_sent=false. Selected host_seconds 8.0473–18.0894 includes 424 added valid windows; bad/pollerr/sat increments all zero, ToF 111–182mm, SQUAL 101–180, all interval records IMU/ToF/flow valid, PWM hard-locked zero. C=[forward,right]=[143.669,-25.011] m·count; integrated roll/pitch/yaw=+5.404/+3.398/-3.825deg. Positive forward response agrees with established axis sign. Approximate 20cm displacement and exact movement endpoints were not independently verified; attitude/height varied, so exclude from scale/rotation fit and do not interpret right component as real lateral drift.
